project: MovieMine – Data Mining Based Movie Recommendation & Preference Analysis System

dataset_provenance.license: CC0: Public Domain / GroupLens Academic License
dataset_provenance.description: Real-world movie metadata and rating interactions extracted from The Movies Dataset (Kaggle) and MovieLens. Processed through a full KDD (Knowledge Discovery in Databases) pipeline including data cleaning, genre vectorization, rating normalization, and user interaction basket creation.

kdd_preprocessing_pipeline.step_1_selection: Extracted high-density subset of 250 top movies across 16 genres with valid TMDB metadata, English and international titles, and authentic IMDb ratings.
kdd_preprocessing_pipeline.step_2_cleaning: Removed duplicate IDs, stripped trailing whitespace, imputed missing runtimes with median duration, and sanitized text overviews.
kdd_preprocessing_pipeline.step_3_transformation: Extracted JSON genre lists into normalized relational junction tables (movie_genres). Scaled ratings to [1.0, 5.0] scale with 0.5 step increments. Created user-movie rating pivot matrix.
kdd_preprocessing_pipeline.step_4_data_mining: Fed clean relational data into Scikit-Learn KMeans clustering, MLxtend Apriori association rule mining, Cosine TF-IDF Content-Based filtering, and User-Based Collaborative Filtering.
kdd_preprocessing_pipeline.step_5_evaluation: Evaluated cluster inertia, rule support/confidence/lift thresholds, and hybrid recommendation weighted scores.
